summary: Unexpected rate reclassification on invoice after hourly postback queue shift
description:
Issue summary:
BrightLoop Labs received invoice INV-2026-00321 with a $3,200 unexpected charge after our monthly cycle. The charge appears to be a reclassification of previously free/hourly-buffered usage into a higher rate tier. Customer reports no configuration changes on their side.

Impact:
- Immediate unexpected charge of $3,200 on a finalized invoice.
- Customer-facing billing alert and support escalation.
- Potential downstream finance impact for the customer's reconciliation.

Environment:
- Production (us-east primary; some postbacks routed through eu-west during the window).
- Customer on enterprise plan with private-network fallback enabled.

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Hourly postback aggregator experienced a short consumer lag between 2026-03-07T02:00Z and 2026-03-07T02:28Z.
2) A backlog replay moved a subset of postbacks into the subsequent hourly window.
3) Reconciler applied rate selection based on the window timestamp; those postbacks fell into a higher-rate bucket (reserved->fallback blended tariff).
4) Hourly-buffer credits were not carried forward due to a tag normalization edgecase during the replay.

Expected behavior:
- Postbacks replayed within reconciliation window should preserve original hourly buffer attribution and not trigger reclassification.

Actual behavior:
- Replayed postbacks were billed at the fallback/reserved-blend rate and omitted from the hourly buffer credit, producing the invoice delta.

Logs / evidence:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/billing/postback-lag?orgId=1&from=2026-03-07T01:50:00Z&to=2026-03-07T03:00:00Z
- SQS/queue metrics show consumer lag spike + replay: message_ids [m-7a9c, m-7b1f, m-7c2d] (referenced in engineering logs).
- Invoice: INV-2026-00321 line items 9-12 show reclassified rate ids (rate_id: RBW-FALLBACK-03).

Attachments:
- Customer email thread (redacted), invoice screenshot, reconciler run logs (link above).
comments: 2026-03-10 10:22 - Support (Ava): Opened with customer-reported unexpected charge. Requested invoice and approximate time window. Notified billing-on-call.
2026-03-10 11:05 - CS (Maya Patel): Customer confirmed no config changes and provided invoice screenshot; urgent for month-end close.
2026-03-10 14:42 - SRE (Devon): Found consumer lag in postback-aggregator; a replay job executed at 2026-03-07T02:25Z. Putting a provisional hold on charge and escalating to billing eng.

2026-03-11 09:30 - Billing Eng (Ravi): Investigating tag normalization in reconciler. Hypothesis: replayed events lost hourly-buffer tag due to migration of tag-namespace tokenizer on 2026-03-01. Creating PR to patch logic.
2026-03-12 16:10 - Support (Ava): Customer notified of provisional credit and ETA for fix. Customer requested confirmation when prod rollout completes.
investigation_notes:
Root cause appears to be twofold: (1) short-lived consumer lag caused a replay of postbacks into the next hourly window, and (2) reconciler's tag normalization function (introduced in a previous release) strips the hourly-buffer tag when ID namespaces exceed 128 chars. Replay path flows did not exercise the preservation code path. Result: rate selector evaluated fallback/reserved blended tariff.
Actions taken so far:
- Recreated replay locally using archived messages and reproduced reclassification.
- Added logging around tag normalization to capture dropped tags.
- Drafted a fix to preserve hourly-buffer tag on replay (PR linked).
- Issued provisional credit to BrightLoop Labs for $3,200 pending reconciliation audit.
resolution_notes:
Provisional credit of $3,200 applied to BrightLoop Labs account and a memo issued to finance (REF: CR-2026-0311-BL). Fix merged to billing-reconciler main (PR #741) and deployed to staging for verification. Scheduled prod rollout for 2026-03-14 during low-traffic window with a targeted reconciliation pass to regenerate any misattributed hourly buffers for affected invoices.
Follow-ups:
- Post-deploy audit to confirm no other tenants affected (assigned INT-442).
- Add automated test for replay-preserve-tags to prevent regression.
- Update runbook to include manual hold step for invoices when replays were detected within reconciliation window.
resolution: Provisional credit issued; fix merged and staged; prod deploy scheduled; follow-up audit planned
notes_for_finance: Applied provisional credit $3,200 (CR-2026-0311-BL). Finance to hold charge reversal pending final audit. Invoice INV-2026-00321 flagged in ledger for adjustment if reconciliation confirms reclassification. Contact: Maya Patel (CS) and Devon Chen (Billing Eng).
next_steps: 1) Deploy reconciler fix to production 2026-03-14. 2) Run reconciliation job for affected invoice IDs and re-generate charge adjustments. 3) Confirm with customer and close ticket after finance confirms final ledger state.
